summary: A public Tourist first-entry depth reward changes the XP percentage highlight rule without changing experience level and with showexp disabled. Native C source says more_experienced calls exp_percent_changing after updating XP; it compares the newly selected rule identity to the last-drawn XP rule and requests a botl redraw when the integer percent changes and the rule identity changes. JS exp_percent_changing currently throws UnsupportedExperienceChangeError whenever an XP highlight rule exists because it has no per-field selected-rule history. The accepted public case differs only at its final status boundary: JS is missing screen/cursor 5 while its 4904 ordered RNG calls match C. The exact JS exception path is causally inferred from source, not dynamically captured.

source.branch: With STATUS_HILITES active, showexp disabled, experience points changed while experience level is unchanged, and the integer XP percentage changes across a configured rule boundary, exp_percent_changing asks get_hilite for the new XP rule and compares its identity to the current status bank’s last-drawn hilite_rule. A different rule requests a full status update. Tourist first-entry depth reward is the selected public trigger.
callers: exper.c:more_experienced assigns new uexp and, when showexp is false and disp.botl is not already set, calls botl.c:exp_percent_changing; C then sets disp.botl on a true result.
do.c:goto_level calls more_experienced for the first-arrival Tourist depth reward; JS counterpart js/do.js:goto_level calls js/exper.js:more_experienced.

allmain.c:moveloop_core invokes botl/timebot at the source-ordered redraw boundaries; JS js/display.js:bot/timebot owns status rendering and js/allmain.js:finishHeroTimeEffects is the once-per-hero-action hook, not the elapsed-world-turn hook.

options.c status-hilite parse/add/clear/remove/reassessment paths call the botl lifecycle and its threshold helpers; corresponding option adapters are in js/options.js and the canonical selector/render state is in js/display.js.
save.c status_finish and win/tty/wintty.c status callback/notification paths participate in teardown and rendering; JS adapters are in js/save.js and js/wintty.js.
dependencies: Source-selected botl.c units include the entire field collector, typed current/previous banks, formatter/converter, selector, notification, initialization, reset, expiry, add/remove, and clear logic.

Existing semantic helpers: exper.c:newuexp / js/exper.js:newuexp for XP boundaries; existing parsed rule objects and status field metadata; existing TTY layout, style, flush and status-window functions. Keep js/exper.js and js/do.js read-only per the reviewed caller pins.

The current source audit found no need for a new generic renderer, generator, metadata file, or C helper outside the pinned 22-unit family. Re-stop if implementation uncovers a value-return dependency or path outside the launch brief.
